using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.Commands;

public class ProjectCreationCommandBaseTests
{
    private class TestProjectCreationCommand : ProjectCreationCommandBase
    {
        public TestProjectCreationCommand()
            : base(
                connectionStringProvider: null,
                solutionPackageVersionFinder: null,
                cmdHelper: null,
                installLibsService: null,
                cliService: null,
                angularPwaSupportAdder: null,
                initialMigrationCreator: null,
                themePackageAdder: null,
                eventBus: null,
                bundlingService: null,
                angularThemeConfigurer: null,
                cliVersionService: null)
        {
        }

        // Expose protected methods for testing if needed
        public new string GetConnectionString(CommandLineArgs args) => base.GetConnectionString(args);
        public new DatabaseProvider GetDatabaseProvider(CommandLineArgs args) => base.GetDatabaseProvider(args);
        public new DatabaseManagementSystem GetDatabaseManagementSystem(CommandLineArgs args) => base.GetDatabaseManagementSystem(args);
        public new UiFramework GetUiFramework(CommandLineArgs args, string template) => base.GetUiFramework(args, template);
        public new MobileApp GetMobilePreference(CommandLineArgs args, string template) => base.GetMobilePreference(args, template);
        public new bool GetCreateSolutionFolderPreference(CommandLineArgs args) => base.GetCreateSolutionFolderPreference(args);

        public new async Task<ProjectBuildArgs> GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(CommandLineArgs commandLineArgs, string template, string projectName)
        {
            return await base.GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(commandLineArgs, template, projectName);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetProjectBuildArgsAsync_LogsConnectionString()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<NewCommand>>();
        var command = new TestProjectCreationCommand();
        command.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

        var args = new CommandLineArgs();
        args.Options["connectionString"] = "my-connection-string";

        // We need to override GetConnectionString to return the connection string from options
        // Since we cannot override easily, we simulate by subclassing and overriding the method
        var commandMock = new Mock<TestProjectCreationCommand> { CallBase = true };
        commandMock.Object.Logger = loggerMock.Object;
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetConnectionString(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>())).Returns("my-connection-string");
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetDatabaseProvider(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>())).Returns(DatabaseProvider.NotSpecified);
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetDatabaseManagementSystem(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>())).Returns(DatabaseManagementSystem.NotSpecified);
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetUiFramework(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>(), It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(UiFramework.NotSpecified);
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetMobilePreference(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>(), It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(MobileApp.None);
        commandMock.Setup(c => c.GetCreateSolutionFolderPreference(It.IsAny<CommandLineArgs>())).Returns(false);

        // Act
        await commandMock.Object.GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(args, "template", "projectName");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Connection string: my-connection-string")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

            // We cannot override non-virtual methods, so we simulate the connection string by setting options
            public string SimulateGetConnectionString(CommandLineArgs args)
            {
                return args.Options.GetOrNull("connectionString");
            }

        [Fact]
        public async Task GetProjectBuildArgsAsync_LogsConnectionString()

            // Arrange

            var args = new CommandLineArgs();
            args.Options["connectionString"] = "my-connection-string";

            // Act
            // We call the real method, which calls GetConnectionString internally
            // Since we cannot override GetConnectionString, we rely on the options dictionary
            await command.GetProjectBuildArgsAsync(args, "template", "projectName");

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Connection string: my-connection-string")),
